_fictional: FICTIONAL RECORDINGS, HAND-WRITTEN, NEVER CAPTURED. This repository has no OPENAI_API_KEY, no GOOGLE_FACTCHECK_API_KEY and no route to either service, so nothing here was recorded from a live API. Every outlet, URL, figure and quotation is invented. See eval/fixtures/README.md.
